newsitem.title: USA: Baron group raises Choice Hotels stake.
newsitem.headline: Baron group raises Choice Hotels stake.

text.p: A group led by New York investor Ronald Baron said Tuesday it raised its stake in Choice Hotels Holdings Inc to 10.8 percent or 6,776,484 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 1,452,600 additional shares of Choice Hotels between November 13 and December 2 at prices ranging from $13.9058 to $15.6875 a share.
The group previously held an 8.5 percent stake or 5,323,884 common shares in the Silver Spring, Md.,-based international lodging firm.
Baron is president of Baron Capital Management Inc, a New York-based investment firm.
